title: Cloud Identity as Enterprise IdP — SAML App Integration Factory (SSO at Scale)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Cloud / identity / Gemini enablement).

Google Cloud Console / gcloud / Cloud Identity / Google Admin authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version- or preview-dependent capabilities (SCC tiers, BeyondCorp features, org-policy constraints, VPC-SC behaviors, Gemini Enterprise features) cited or flagged 'verify in your organization', never invented. IaC (Terraform / Cloud Foundation Toolkit) at the pattern level. Automation is Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries) — no hardcoded credentials, no committed service-account keys, no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Make Google the single sign-on identity provider for your SaaS estate
problem: In a Google-first enterprise, Cloud Identity / Google Workspace becomes the IdP for hundreds of SaaS apps — but onboarding each SAML/OIDC app one-off is slow and inconsistent. This solution builds a repeatable SAML app-integration factory: a standard onboarding pattern (SAML & OIDC), auto-provisioning where supported, group-based app assignment, and a catalog/runbook — so new apps are federated to Google SSO fast, consistently, and securely.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — Google as IdP: SAML vs OIDC, the app catalog, auto-provisioning, group-based assignment, and the repeatable onboarding pattern.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Cloud Identity/Workspace tenant + super-admin, groups source of truth, per-app admin access).

Implementation Guide — define the onboarding pattern, integrate a pilot set of SAML/OIDC apps, wire auto-provisioning + group-based assignment, and publish the catalog/runbook — then scale the factory.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (SSO works, provisioning correct, assignment group-driven) plus Best Practices for a consistent, auditable app-integration program.
short: Build a SAML app-integration factory with Cloud Identity/Workspace as IdP — a repeatable SAML/OIDC onboarding pattern, auto-provisioning, group-based assignment, and a catalog — so the SaaS estate federates to Google SSO fast and consistently. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
